You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def fit(name):
    I=G[name+' input'];O=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    fig=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==8]
    seeds=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=8]
    rs=[a for a,b in fig];cs=[b for a,b in fig]
    cmin,cmax=min(rs),min(cs); rmin,rmax=max(rs),max(cs)
    import itertools
    best=[]
    for flip_v in [False,True]:
        for flip_h in [False,True]:
            for sc in [1,2]:
                sy=lambda r:(rmin if flip_v else rmax)-r if flip_v else r-rmin
                sx=lambda c:(cmin if flip_h else cmax)-c if flip_h else c-cmin
                ok=True; mm=0
                for (r,c) in fig:
                    rr=rmin+sy(r)*sc; cc=cmin+sx(c)*sc
                    # clamp & nearest seed
                    bests=[]
                    for s in seeds:
                        d=abs(rr-s[0])+abs(cc-s[1])
                        bests.append((d,s[2]))
                    d_,v=min(bests)
                    if v!=O[r][c]: ok=False;mm+=1
                best.append((flip_v,flip_h,sc,mm,ok))
    return best
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(name, fit(name))

def segments(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    fig=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==8]
    rs=sorted({r for r,c in fig}); cs=sorted({c for r,c in fig})
    segs=[]
    cur=None
    for r in rs:
        cols=sorted({c for rr,cc in fig if rr==r})
        # group contiguous col-runs
        runs=[];start=cols[0]
        for cc in cols[1:]:
            if cc==start: start=cc
            elif cc>start: runs.append((start,cc-1))
            else: start=cc
        last=cols[-1]; runs.append((last,last))
        for a,b in runs:
            segs.append({'rows':(r,r),'cols':(a,b),'cells':sum(1 for rr in [r] for cc in range(a,b+1))})
    return segs

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I1,O1=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
fig=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I1)) for c in range(len(I1[0])) if I1[r][c]==8]

h=max(r for r,c in fig)-mr+1; w=max(c for r,c in fig)-mc+1
seeds=[(r,c,I1[r][c]) for r in range(len(I1)) for c in range(len(I1[0])) if I1[r][c] not in (0,8)]
srs=min(a for a,b,_ in seeds); scs=min(b for _,b,_ in seeds)
S={(r-srs,c-scs):v for r,c,v in seeds}
OM=[[O1[mr+i][mc+j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
print('S:')
for r in range(max(p[0] for p in S)+1): print([S.get((r,c),'.') for c in range(max(p[1] for p in S)+1)])
# union-over-alignments test

def solve(G):
    Hh=len(G); Ww=len(G[0])
    fig=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh) for c in range(Ww) if G[r][c]==8]
    rs=[p[0] for p in fig]; cs=[p[1] for p in fig]
    rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    srows=[[G[r][c] for c in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for r in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
    R=rot90(srows); h=len(R)
    # tile size: uniform tile covering figure evenly (demo: tile = figsize/seedsize; use floor with even division)
    th=rmax-rmin+1; tw=cmax-cmin+1
    tile=max(1,(th//h)) if th%h==0 else max(1,th//h)
    out=[row[:] for row in G]
    for a in range(0,th,tile):
        for b in range(0,tw,tile):
            val=R[a//tile if False else 0][0]  # placeholder
    # proper: band index = a//tile, use R[(a//tile)][(b//tile)] but R may be larger than bands; clamp

            ri=a//tile; rj=b//tile
            val=R[ri%h][rj%len(R[0])]
            if val==0: continue
            for i in range(a,min(a+tile,th)):
                for j in range(b,min(b+tile,tw)):
                    out[i][j]=val
    return out

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
